description: Reads a purchase this chat asked for: whether the owner approved it, whether it was paid, the service's answer and the receipt. Show the owner the approval link and match code before calling this tool. Then keep calling it with wait_seconds 25 in the same turn while the result says to keep waiting. It also works when called later. A payment whose outcome is not known yet is reported as unknown, never as unpaid.

wait_seconds.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds until the purchase is final. Use 25 while the owner has not approved yet.

name: get_purchase_status
title: Get a purchase's status
